notes: Torah #40 has zero cause/effect (eitza or cause type) edges in the torahData.js dataset with reference 40. Despite the source text being highly eitza-dominant in its argument structure (idolatry → travel, idolatry → no rain → no satiation → no peace → more travel, neglect of Torah → exile), none of these causal chains are recorded as eitza/cause edges in the dataset. The dataset contains only 2 bechina edges for this Torah. Consequently, there are no unassigned cause/effect nodes to enrich into packages.
